Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000877" [decision]: As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, taking over from the Cinder team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000623" [constraint]: The product catalog deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000336": In the product catalog, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000332" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: product catalog, image metadata)
- memory_id "1000319": The product catalog depends on the image resizer for thumbnails.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000156": The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000893": As of 2025-12-25, the Atlas team sits on the second floor.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000340" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000874" [decision]: As of 2025-12-18, the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, since incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.  (about: indexer)
- memory_id "1000906": feature-flags is not the Atlas team's service, so the Atlas team flagged feature-flags' queue depth issue.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000902": The Atlas team saw that feature-flags' queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, the marketing send)
- memory_id "1000706": The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000910" [decision]: As of 2026-01-12, the billing API is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then.  (about: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000885": The Atlas team observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change.  (about: Atlas team, reports pipeline, the retention change)
- memory_id "1000723": From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000561" [decision]: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000743": The Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the image resizer's owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer, the marketing send)
- memory_id "1000727": As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000810" [decision]: As of 2025-11-26, the image resizer is owned by the Atlas team, taking over from the Ember team.  (about: Atlas team, Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000778" [decision]: As of 2025-11-06, feature-flags is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000567": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team pager instead of Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
Existing entity names: Atlas team, Cinder team, product catalog, image metadata, image resizer, indexer, the bus, feature-flags, the marketing send, billing API, Ember team, reports pipeline, the retention change, ledger service, Priya Raman, Tomasz
